observation.visible_scene: A stainless steel pot sits on crumpled aluminum foil. Inside the pot is a shallow pool of pale yellowish liquid containing a soft, opaque white mass (roughly heart/lobe shaped) and a smaller white patch to the left. A metal spoon rests in the liquid with its bowl near the lower left, and a thin dark rod/stick leans diagonally against the pot's rim, rising toward the upper right. The camera view is fixed throughout.
visible_changes: Over the clip the white mass slowly changes shape and shrinks slightly, its edges becoming smoother and more rounded, consistent with a solid gradually melting/dissolving into the surrounding liquid.
The smaller white patch on the left likewise deforms and reduces a little, with tiny surface bubbles appearing/shifting on it.
The dark rod and spoon handle remain in essentially the same positions; no stirring or contact with them is seen.
The overall liquid level and the foil/pot background stay unchanged; the camera does not move.
outside_clip_unknowns: The identity of the white substance and the liquid, and whether any heat source or stirring occurs outside this segment.
What happens before the first frame or after the last frame (the excerpt shows an already-ongoing, slow change, not its start or completion).
uncertain_details: Whether the white mass is melting (heat-driven) or dissolving (into the liquid) cannot be determined from the frames alone.
Subtle surface/level changes in the liquid are hard to distinguish from lighting/reflection shifts on the metal.
